text: {"lessons":["I repeatedly sold positions at gains, then made no trades as the account later declined; neither locking in gains nor avoiding a loss should replace a consistent plan for each holding.","A stock being above or below my average cost does not tell me whether to buy, sell, or hold; I should base decisions on my portfolio rules, not the urge to realize gains or avoid admitting a mistake.","The recent account decline does not predict what comes next. Since I check infrequently, I should set sensible allocation and review rules in advance rather than react to short-term moves."]}
